lines: When stars twinkle above the darkened sky,
And whispers of the night arise,
The dreams of my solitude rise fresh,
My heart turns cold and wise.
Then seek solace, soul, the moon is gone,
And shadows stretch their long arms wide;
Your summer and dreams are wasted in flight,
And your winter and night in embrace.
When stars twinkle in velvet skies,
And dreams take flight at midnight's call,
The tales of the wise rise in my eyes,
Their echoes fade, their light grows cold.
Then turn back, my dreams, the dawn is near,
And the daybreak whispers softly;
Your evening and twilight are spent,
And your dusk and shadows in mockery.
When stars twinkle in twilight's soft embrace,
And shadows dance along the hill,
The nights of my dreams rise clear in my heart,
My spirit lifts, as light fills still.
Then drift off to sleep, my visions are done,
And silence holds its breath;
Your joy and your wonder are wasted in dreams,
And your fears and your doubts in retreat.
When twilight whispers secrets low,
Beneath the vast, unlit sky,
The world in hushed tones begins to flow,
A stage for dreams to fly.
Stars, they twirl like ancient lovers' eyes,
Their gaze a gentle caress,
While moonbeams kiss the dew-kissed skies,
In silver threads they trace.
Silhouettes cast long shadows here,
Of figures lost in thought,
Their whispers echo through the air,
A melody profound.
Yet soon the day will break this spell,
As light reclaims the night,
And dreams, like fleeting flowers, will tell,
Their tales before they die.
When shadows dance upon the walls,
And stars begin their nightly ballet,
A dream begins in quiet halls,
Where thoughts take flight, yet stay entwined.
Through windows wide, the world retreats,
Leaving only echoes of the mind.
Each memory, a thread so tight,
Weaves tales of joy and heartache kind.
Yet in this realm, where fears may hide,
Our spirits soar, unbound and free.
For in the dusk, our souls abide,
And dreams become the guiding light.
When stars twinkle in velvet skies so vast,
And shadows dance beneath the moon's gaze,
The tales of old heroes rise in my heart,
Their courage shines like morning's first blaze.
Then seek solace, dear ones, as dawn breaks through,
And light the path where shadows lie;
For dreams and aspirations are lost in haste,
Yet hope and wonder still hold their own high.
When stars twinkle above darkened skies,
And dreams take flight at night,
The nights of my dreams rise fresh in mind,
My heart grows cold and lightless.
When whispers fill the quiet dawn,
And birdsong cuts through sleepy skies,
The days of my thoughts awake within,
Their wings unfurl, as hope takes flight.
Then let go of tomorrow's worries,
And let today bloom like a rose;
Your strength and your courage are found,
In moments where you choose to grow.
When whispers fill the silent night,
And moonlight bathes the quiet trees,
A secret whispered through the dark,
Becomes a story, pure and free.
Then drift off to sleep, your fears gone,
And secrets lie where dreams do rest;
Your joy and your wonder awake,
In the quiet, your soul does best.
When stars align and constellations dance,
Above the silent, starlit sky,
A tale of love, both sweet and fraught,
Weaves through the night, a wistful sigh.
Then let the dawn break, casting light,
On shadows cast from dreams so dear;
Your heart, though tender, finds its way,
To brighter skies, a hopeful steer.
When laughter of lads dances under moonlight,
Their spirits bright as stars above,
The nights of my dreams unfold in my mind,
My heart beats fast, my blood flows low.
Then come back, my lads, the night has passed away,
And shadows stretch upon the earth;
Your summer and summer are wasted in fun,
And your autumn and fall in despair.
When stars twinkle in velvet skies,
And dreams dance on the moonlit sea,
A memory blooms within my heart,
Of laughter lost in morning light.
Then come home, my dreams, the dawn has passed,
And shadows grow long and deep;
Your twilight tales are wasted in night,
While your day of light fades steep.
When moonlight bathes the silent night,
And whispers softly through the trees,
The dreams of my waking thoughts ignite,
As secrets held in darkness tease.
Then drift off to day, my worries are gone,
And laughter dances in my soul;
Your hopes and your strength are made known,
And your courage shines in the coal.
When stars align above,
And shadows dance upon the wall,
A tale of love unfolds,
In whispers, sweet and pale.
Then drift into the night,
Where dreams and hearts entwine,
Joy and sorrow blend,
In quiet, tender line.
When dawn breaks and the sky awakes,
With hues of rose and gold aglow,
The world awakens from its sleep,
A symphony of light below.
In gardens where the roses bloom,
And birds take flight to greet the day,
Nature sings a joyful tune,
In every breath, a sacred ray.
Yet as the sun climbs higher still,
And shadows grow long once more,
We find ourselves in quiet stillness,
Where hearts and souls can softly soar.
When shadows creep under the moonlit eaves,
And silent stars weep their lone tears,
The nights of my dreams rise clear in my heart,
My breath grows shallow and fierce.
Then come back, my visions, the night is done,
And the whispers of dawn stir;
Your summer and bloom are wasted in haste,
And your autumn and leaves in despair.
When stars twinkle in skies so vast and deep,
And tales of ancient dreams we weave,
The nights of my soul rise clear and bright,
My heart grows light, my spirit free.
Then come home, my dreams, the moon has set,
And shadows stretch across the land;
Your laughter and joy are wasted in haste,
And your sorrow and night in bland.
When moonlight bathes the quiet shore,
And waves whisper secrets old,
My soul awakes, a silent choir,
In harmony, it unfolds.
Then drift off to sleep, my thoughts unwind,
And silence holds its hush;
Your hopes and your dreams take flight tonight,
And your sorrows find rest in dusk.
When dawn breaks, light spills over hills,
And shadows dance upon the ground,
A traveler, weary yet alive,
Recounts his journey's winding round.
Through forests dense, where paths are lost,
And rivers swift, beneath the sun,
He finds a strength within himself,
That guides him on, through all the fun.
Yet as he rests, beneath the stars,
His thoughts return to life's small joys,
Of laughter shared, and dreams that soar,
In quiet moments, pure and wise.
When dawn breaks over the sleepy town,
And birdsong greets the morning light,
A memory, soft as morning dew,
Stirs within the hollowed heart.
Then walk the paths where laughter danced,
And shadows played among the trees;
Your spirit lifts with every step,
In the warmth of memories' ease.
As sun climbs high, casting gold upon,
The fields and hills so verdant green,
Your mind wanders through the days gone by,
In the quiet, your soul does glean.
